newsitem.title: JAPAN: July China Daqing price calculated at $17.15/bbl.
newsitem.headline: July China Daqing price calculated at $17.15/bbl.

text.p: China's Daqing crude oil price for July lifting to Japanese customers has been calculated at $17.15 per barrel, down 25 cents from June, traders here said on Friday.
The Daqing price is linked to the average of Indonesia's official prices for Minas and Cinta crudes.
Japanese buyers have accepted a Chinese offer to allocate six million to eight million tonnes per year for the 1996-2000 period.
China reviews its Daqing export volume every five years.
